review_scope: Independent read-only design review of no-pdf-v1 revision 1 contract and exact frozen path allowlist.

findings.detail: The baseline tiny.pdf is 674 bytes with SHA-256 c37df90f89d97fd1e575ee894c8fce6c2a979b2de76332a20105f1af70d8c7b9; sectioned.pdf is 1206 bytes with SHA-256 03645f6fdd81c46f7377ab28602aa070e51109c0c95500f06496d07de1badc4b. Their readable object dictionaries, text streams, fixed binary PDF header markers, computed object offsets, xref, and trailer can be reconstructed without embedding an encoded blob. Builder acceptance must compare generated bytes to these exact hashes and sizes.

A lazy module-owned tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=..., dir="/tmp") root with one randomized directory per process, retained for the process lifetime and cleaned by a normal-exit hook, satisfies short real temporary path, no fixed-name sharing, and no repository writes. The name-to-path map must accept only tiny and sectioned and reject unknown/path-like names; it must never accept a caller path or overwrite outside the private root.

The 24 consumers are module-level path users, so the helper must be safe during pytest collection and keep generated files alive through the whole process. Existing subprocess consumers read parent-loaded bytes or use their own runtime generator; no subprocess should import tests/pdf_samples. Acceptance must run collection and the installed-layout/security tests, not only the focused generator tests.

The ignore rule must match *.[Pp][Dd][Ff] at any depth. The workflow guard must run after checkout and before dependency setup, parse git ls-files -z safely (including whitespace/newlines), reject every case variant of a tracked .pdf path, and leave matrix/permissions/timeouts unchanged. Focused tests may use temporary names and git check-ignore/temporary repos but must never create a tracked PDF in the real checkout.

The generated tiny sample must retain one page, title/text, and the legacy malformed-length declaration as byte parity requires; sectioned must retain two pages and the exact title, Abstract/Introduction/Method text streams. Existing parser and fixed-slot/path-safety assertions remain unchanged. Focused tests should verify pypdf page/title/text semantics plus exact bytes.

acceptance_conditions: Builder changes only the exact 30 allowed paths and deletes both tracked PDFs.
Generated bytes match both frozen hashes and sizes in a fresh process.
No case-insensitive .pdf path remains in the prospective tracked tree; workflow guard passes before dependency setup.
Full locked Python 3.12/3.13 suites and focused affected consumers pass with short real temporary roots.
Normal process cleanup is observed or the implementation has an equivalent bounded cleanup proof; no external download or production-code change occurs.
